Drawer

A panel sliding in from an edge: a RayDialog (focus, Escape, persistent, data-dialog-close, returnValue) with another look; modeless for side panels that keep the page interactive.

API

For AI agents: this API as Markdown, or every component in llms-full.txt.

<ray-drawer> · RayDrawer

Any slotted element with data-dialog-close closes it. JS: show(), close(returnValue).

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
openopen reflectsbooleanShown.
labellabelstringHeading (also the accessible name).
descriptiondescriptionstringA line under the title (the drawer's accessible description).
positionposition reflectsend | start | right | left | top | bottomendThe edge it slides from: start/end follow the writing direction; left/right are sides of the screen.
sizesize reflectsstringmdWidth (left/right) or height (top/bottom): xs…xl, full, or any CSS length.
modelessmodeless reflectsbooleanNo backdrop nor scroll lock: the page stays interactive (a side panel).
floatingfloating reflectsbooleanDetached from the edge, with rounded corners.
persistentpersistent reflectsbooleanEscape and backdrop clicks do not close it.
hideClosehide-close reflectsbooleanNo close button in the header.
overlayBluroverlay-blurstringBlur of the page behind: px ("8"), a CSS length or "none". Default: --ray-overlay-blur ([overlay] blur in tokens.toml).
EventDescription
ray-openAfter it opened.
ray-closeAfter it closed; detail: { returnValue }.
ray-request-closeEscape, backdrop or close button; cancelable.
SlotDescription
(default)Body (scrolls).
headerExtra header content.
footerActions, at the bottom.
PartDescription
drawerThe native <dialog>.
bodyThe body.
